explanation: Centripetal force F = mv²/r = (2 × 10²) / 4 = 200 / 4 = 50 N.

subject: Physics
question: If it takes an object 3s to fall freely to the ground from a certain height, what is the distance covered by the object? [g = 10ms⁻²]
explanation: Distance s = ut + ½gt² = 0 + ½(10)(3)² = 5 × 9 = 45 m.

question:
[DIAGRAM: Positions of a cone: X inverted on apex, Y upright on base, Z resting on its side]
The diagrams above show the positions of a cone. The position which can be described as neutral equilibrium is represented as _____
explanation: A cone resting on its curved lateral side (Z) is in neutral equilibrium because rolling it does not change the height of its center of gravity.

subject: Physics
question: If a tube of small radius opened at both ends is placed in a liquid, the liquid will _____

options.A: rise above the liquid level if the liquid does not wet the glass
options.B: remain at the same level irrespective of whether the liquid wets the glass or not
options.C: fall below the liquid level if the liquid wets the glass
options.D: fall below the liquid level if the liquid does not wet the glass.

explanation: Capillarity: Liquids that do not wet glass (e.g. mercury) experience capillary depression (meniscus falls below liquid level).

subject: Physics
question:
I. Density of the liquid
II. Depth below the surface of the liquid
III. Surface area of the liquid

In which of the statement above will pressure be dependent?
explanation: Hydrostatic pressure P = hρg, which depends strictly on depth (h) and density (ρ), and is independent of cross-sectional/surface area.

subject: Physics
question:
I. High thermal capacity
II. High sensitivity
III. Easy readability
IV. Accuracy over a wide range of temperatures

From the statements above, the qualities of a good thermometer are
explanation: A good thermometer must possess low thermal capacity (so it does not absorb significant heat from the substance), high sensitivity, easy readability, and wide range accuracy.

subject: Physics
question: A machine is used to lift a load of 20 N through a height of 10m. If the efficiency of the machine is 40%, how much work is done?
explanation: Work output = Load × distance = 20 × 10 = 200 J. Work input = Work output / Efficiency = 200 / 0.40 = 500 J.

subject: Physics
question: Which of the following could be effectively used to reduce friction?
explanation: Grease and lubricants form a fluid layer between moving contact surfaces, significantly reducing friction.

subject: Physics
question: A copper wire was subjected to a tensile stress of 7.7 × 10⁷ Nm⁻². Calculate the tensile strain of the wire. [Young modulus = 1.1 × 10¹¹ Nm⁻²]
explanation: Young's modulus E = Stress / Strain ⇒ Strain = Stress / E = (7.7 × 10⁷) / (1.1 × 10¹¹) = 7.0 × 10⁻⁴.

subject: Physics
question: An object weighs 22kg in water and 30kg in air. What is the up thrust exerted by the liquid on the object? [g = 10 ms⁻²]
explanation: Upthrust = Weight in air - Weight in water = (30 - 22) × 10 = 8 × 10 = 80 N.

subject: Physics
question: A block of aluminium is heated electrically by a 30 W heater. If the temperature rises by 100˚C in 5 minutes, the heat capacity of the aluminium is ____
explanation: Heat supplied Q = P × t = 30 W × (5 × 60 s) = 9000 J. Heat capacity C = Q / Δθ = 9000 / 100 = 90 JK⁻¹.

subject: Physics
question: A perfect emitter or absorber of radiant energy is a _____
explanation: A black body is a theoretical idealized physical body that absorbs all incident electromagnetic radiation and is also the best emitter.

subject: Physics
question: The phenomenon that shows that increase in pressure lowers the melting point can be observed in _____
explanation: Regelation is the phenomenon of ice melting under pressure and refreezing when the pressure is reduced.

subject: Physics
question: If the volume of a gas increases steadily as the temperature decreases at constant pressure, the gas obeys _____
explanation: Charles's law relates volume and absolute temperature at constant pressure: V ∝ T.

subject: Physics
question: Steam burn is more severe than that of boiling water because _____

options.A: steam burn is dependent on relative humidity
options.B: steam burn is independent of relative humidity
options.C: steam possess greater heat energy per unit mass
options.D: water boils at a higher temperature

explanation: Steam contains specific latent heat of vaporization (approx. 2.26 × 10⁶ J/kg) in addition to the sensible heat of boiling water.

subject: Physics
question: Which of the following types of waves needs a medium for propagation?
explanation: Sound waves are mechanical longitudinal waves and require a material medium (solid, liquid, or gas) to propagate.

subject: Physics
question: The ground is always cold at night because the _____

options.A: atmosphere reflects the sun’s energy at night
options.B: atmosphere absorbs the sun’s energy at night
options.C: earth radiates heat to the atmosphere at night
options.D: sun no longer shines at night

explanation: During nighttime, the earth's surface radiates terrestrial thermal infrared radiation into the cooler atmosphere.

II. Diffusion
III. Radiation
IV. Osmosis

Which of the processes above can be explained using the kinetic theory?
explanation: Kinetic molecular theory explains matter phenomena involving particulate motion (Change of state, Diffusion, Osmosis). Radiation is an electromagnetic wave process.

subject: Physics
question: When the human eye loses its power of accommodation, the defect is known as _____
explanation: Presbyopia is the progressive age-related loss of the eye's ability to focus on nearby objects due to loss of lens elasticity and ciliary muscle weakening.

subject: Physics
question: A length of wire has a frequency of 255Hz when stretched by a force of 225 N. If the force increases to 324 N, what is the new frequency of vibration?
explanation: Frequency of stretched string f ∝ √T ⇒ f₂ / f₁ = √(T₂ / T₁) = √(324 / 225) = 18 / 15 = 1.2 ⇒ f₂ = 255 × 1.2 = 306 Hz.

subject: Physics

subject: Physics
question: Which of the following electromagnetic waves has the highest frequency?
explanation: Electromagnetic spectrum in order of increasing frequency: Radio < Infrared < Visible < UV < X-rays < Gamma rays.

subject: Physics
question: When a red rose flower is observed in blue light, what colour does the observer see?
explanation: A red surface absorbs blue light and reflects red; under pure blue light with no red component, it appears black, but under blue illumination it absorbs blue showing dark/blue reflection.

subject: Physics
question: The eclipse of the sun occurs when the _____

options.A: moon’s umbra falls on some part of the earth
options.B: moon is between the sun and the earth
options.C: earth is between the sun and the moon
options.D: moon is not completely hidden in the earth’s shadow.

explanation: Solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes directly between the Sun and Earth, casting its shadow on Earth.

subject: Physics
question: A cannon is fired from town X. After how long is the sound heard at a town Y 4.95 km away? [velocity of sound in air = 333 ms⁻¹]
explanation: Time t = Distance / Speed = 4950 m / 333 ms⁻¹ ≈ 14.86 s ≈ 15 s.

subject: Physics
question: An image in a convex lens is upright magnified 3 times. If the focal length of the lens is 15cm, what is the object distance?
explanation: Magnification m = v/u = 3 ⇒ v = -3u (virtual upright image). 1/f = 1/u + 1/v ⇒ 1/15 = 1/u - 1/(3u) = 2/(3u) ⇒ 3u = 30 ⇒ u = 10 cm.

subject: Physics
question: The capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor is 20 μF in air and 60 μF in the presence of a dielectric. What is the dielectric constant?
explanation: Dielectric constant εr = C_dielectric / C_air = 60 μF / 20 μF = 3.0.

subject: Physics
question:
[DIAGRAM: Three parallel resistors 2Ω, 4Ω, 12Ω connected across 12V battery]
In the circuit below, three resistors, 2Ω, 4 Ω and 12 Ω are connected in parallel and a 12 V battery is connected across the combination. The current flowing through the 12 Ω resistor is ____
explanation: In parallel, voltage across each resistor is the full 12 V. Current I = V / R = 12 V / 12 Ω = 1.0 A.

subject: Physics
question: The correct expression for the potential at a point, distance r from a charge q, in an electric field is _____
explanation: Electric potential V = q / (4πε₀r). Electric field intensity is E = q / (4πε₀r²).

subject: Physics
question: Three similar cells each of e.m.f 2V and internal resistance 2 Ω are connected in parallel, the total e.m.f and total internal resistance are respectively _____
explanation: For identical cells in parallel: Total EMF = EMF of one cell = 2 V. Total internal resistance r_total = r / n = 2 / 3 ≈ 0.67 Ω ≈ 0.7 Ω.

subject: Physics
question: In homes, electrical appliances and lamps are connected in parallel because _____

options.B: parallel connection does not heat up the wires

explanation: Parallel wiring ensures that if one appliance is switched off or damaged, others continue operating independently with standard mains voltage.

subject: Physics
question: Two resistors 5 Ω and 10 Ω are arranged first in series and later in parallel to a 24 V source. The ratio of total power dissipated in the series and parallel arrangement respectively is _____
explanation: Series resistance R_s = 15 Ω, P_s = V²/R_s = 24²/15 = 576/15 = 38.4 W. Parallel resistance R_p = (5×10)/15 = 10/3 Ω, P_p = 24²/(10/3) = 172.8 W. Ratio P_s : P_p = 38.4 / 172.8 = 2/9 ≈ 3:5.

subject: Physics
question: Which of the following will be applied when a metal X is electroplated with metal Y?

options.A: Y is the anode and very high current is used
options.B: X is the anode and very high current is used
options.C: X is the cathode and Y is the anode
options.D: Y is the cathode and X is the anode

explanation: In electroplating, the article to be coated (X) is made the cathode, and the plating metal (Y) is made the anode.

options.A: It can easily be magnetized and demagnetized
options.B: It cannot retain its magnetism longer than iron
options.C: It can be used for making temporary magnets
options.D: It can be used for making permanent magnets

explanation: Steel is a magnetically hard ferromagnetic material with high retentivity and coercivity, making it ideal for permanent magnets.

subject: Physics

explanation: Gases become electrical conductors in discharge tubes at low pressure and high potential difference.

explanation: Pure metals have a positive temperature coefficient of resistance (resistance increases with rising temperature due to enhanced lattice phonon scattering).

subject: Physics
question: The electrical properties of semiconductor can be altered drastically by the addition of impurities. The process is referred to as _____
explanation: Doping is the intentional introduction of specific trivalent or pentavalent impurity atoms into an intrinsic semiconductor to modulate its electrical conductivity.

subject: Physics
question: In order to remove the error of parallax when taking measurements with a metre rule, the eye should be focused _____

options.A: slantingly towards the left on the markings
options.B: slantingly towards the right on the markings

explanation: To prevent parallax error, the line of sight must be perpendicular (vertically downwards) to the scale markings.

subject: Physics
question: A load is pulled at a uniform speed along horizontal floor by a rope at 45⁰ to floor. If the force in the rope is 1500N, what is the frictional force on the load?
explanation: At constant velocity, horizontal pulling force balances friction: F_friction = F cos(45°) = 1500 × 0.7071 = 1060.65 N ≈ 1061 N.

explanation: F = G(M_e m) / r². As distance r increases away from Earth, gravitational pull decreases (inversely proportional to r²).

subject: Physics
question: If a freely suspended object is pulled to one side and released, it oscillates about the point of suspension because the _____

options.A: acceleration is directly proportional to the displacement
options.B: motion is directed away from the equilibrium point
options.C: acceleration is directly proportional to the square of the displacement

subject: Physics
question: The pressure at any point in a liquid at rest depends only on the _____
explanation: Hydrostatic pressure P = hρg, depending solely on liquid depth and liquid density.

subject: Physics
question: A balloon whose volume is 300m³ is filled with hydrogen. If the density of air is 1.3kgm⁻³, find the up thrust on the balloon. [g ≈10ms⁻²]
explanation: Upthrust = Weight of displaced air = V × ρ_air × g = 300 × 1.3 × 10 = 3900 N.

explanation: General gas law: (P₁V₁)/T₁ = (P₂V₂)/T₂ ⇒ V₂ = (700 × 2000 × 273) / (760 × 300) = 1676.3 cm³.

options.A: Increase in the pressure of the atmosphere
options.C: Increase in the average speed of the molecules of water
options.D: Increase in the kinetic energy of the molecules of water.

explanation: Higher atmospheric pressure suppresses vaporization and decreases the rate of evaporation.

subject: Physics
question: The quantity of heat energy required to melt completely 1kg of ice at -30°C is _____ [latent heat of fusion = 3.5 × 10⁵ Jkg⁻¹, specific heat capacity of ice = 2.1 × 10³ Jkg⁻¹ K⁻¹]

question:

explanation: Brownian motion occurs in both liquids and gases (fluids), confirming particulate structure and perpetual random thermal motion.

subject: Physics
question: Which of the following factors will affect the velocity of sound?

options.A: An increase in the pitch of the sound
options.B: An increase in the loudness of the sound
options.C: Wind travelling in the same direction of the sound
options.D: A change in the atmospheric pressure at constant temperature.

explanation: Wind superimposes its velocity vector on sound propagation (v = v_sound + v_wind).

subject: Physics
question: The characteristics of a vibration that determines its intensity is the _____
explanation: Intensity of a wave is directly proportional to the square of its amplitude (I ∝ A²).

Which of the statements above are conditions for total internal reflection to occur?
explanation: Total internal reflection occurs strictly when light travels from an optically denser to rarer medium (III) and the angle of incidence exceeds the critical angle (II).

subject: Physics

explanation: Dispersion is the splitting of polychromatic white light into its constituent spectral colors when refracted through a dispersive medium.

subject: Physics
question: A newly charged 12V accumulator can easily start a car whereas eight new dry cells in series with an effective e.m.f. of 12V cannot start the same car because _____

question:

options.A: Neutral side of an electric supply
options.B: Earth side of an electric supply
options.C: Live side of an electric supply

explanation: The safety fuse must always be connected in series with the live lead so that blowing the fuse isolates the appliance from high voltage.

question:

explanation: Capacitive reactance Xc = 1 / (2πfC), displaying an inverse hyperbolic decay as frequency increases.

question: The current output form of an a.c. source is given as I = 10 sin ωt. The d.c. equivalent of the current is

explanation: N / N₀ = 125 / 1000 = 1/8 = (½)³. Number of half-lives n = 3. Total time t = 3 × 20 s = 60 seconds.

explanation: Reverse bias pulls majority charge carriers away from the junction, widening the depletion layer and increasing the barrier potential.
